analogy.rationale: Mineralocorticoid receptor agonists act on NR3C2, which is closely related to the glucocorticoid receptor (NR3C1); these cells express low levels of NR3C2, so responses should be weak, with the most similar transcriptional profiles coming from other nuclear receptor ligands such as glucocorticoid receptor agonists and steroid hormones.
